title: Part 1 照片描述
goal: 人物动作、物品状态、场景位置；现在进行时被动

steps.title: Part 1 是什么样的题
lines: A woman is pouring coffee into a cup.
一位女士正往杯子里倒咖啡。
A man is examining some documents.
一名男子正在仔细查看文件。
Some people are boarding a bus.
一些人正在上公交车。
A worker is sweeping the floor.
一名工人正在扫地。
steps.note: TOEIC Part 1 共 6 题：看一张照片，听 4 句描述，选最符合的一句。人物照的正确答案几乎都是“主语 + is / are + doing”。

steps.title: 人物照：现在进行时 is / are doing
what: 人物照的描述几乎都是 主语 + is / are + 动词 -ing：A woman is pouring coffee.
先看清两件事：谁（a man / some people / one of the women）和 在做什么（手在干什么、身体什么姿势）。
why: Part 1 只描述照片里看得见的东西。“他正在准备开会”（看不出来）、“她刚买了这本书”（推测）一律是错的。
TOEIC 爱用具体动词：examine（仔细看）、adjust（调整）、reach for（伸手拿）、lean against（靠着），平时要把这些动作动词和画面绑在一起记。
zh: 中文描述照片常说“一个男人在看文件”，英语要选准动词：look at（看）/ examine（仔细检查）/ read（读）在 Part 1 里都可能出现，听到哪个就对应哪个动作。
ex: A man is adjusting a microphone.
一名男子正在调整麦克风。
Some passengers are boarding a train.
一些乘客正在上火车。
One of the women is lifting a box.
其中一位女士正在搬起一个箱子。
err: A man is going to the meeting.
A man is walking down a hallway.
去开会是推测，只描述看得见的动作
She pours coffee.
She is pouring coffee.
照片里的动作用进行时
steps.sum: 主语 + is / are + doing；只说看得见的，不说推测。

drill.q: 【照片】一名男子手扶着墙站着　哪一句描述正确？
o: A man is painting a wall.
A man is building a wall.
A man is leaning against a wall.

drill.q: 【照片】一位女士踮脚伸手去拿柜子顶层的箱子　哪一句描述正确？
o: A woman is opening a box.
A woman is reaching for a box.
A woman is putting a box on the floor.

a: A worker is sweeping the floor.
A janitor is sweeping the floor.

x: A man is leaning against a wall.
一名男子靠在墙上。
She's reaching for a book on the shelf.
她正伸手去拿架子上的书。
A man is wiping the table.
一名男子正在擦桌子。
A worker is kneeling down to fix the pipe.
一名工人跪着修管子。

steps.title: wearing（状态）≠ putting on（动作）
what: is wearing a hat：戴着帽子（状态）
is putting on a hat：正在戴上帽子（动作）
is taking off a jacket：正在脱外套
why: 这是 Part 1 出现频率最高的陷阱之一。照片里人已经戴着眼镜 → 选 wearing；只有手正拿着眼镜往脸上戴 → 才选 putting on。
zh: 中文“戴”“穿”既可以是动作也可以是状态，英语分成两个说法。
ex: The woman is wearing glasses.
那位女士戴着眼镜。
The man is putting on a safety helmet.
那名男子正在戴上安全帽。
err: （照片：她戴着帽子坐着）She is putting on a hat.
She is wearing a hat.
已经戴着 → wearing
steps.sum: wearing = 穿着 / 戴着（状态）；putting on = 正在穿 / 戴（动作）。

drill.q: 【照片】一名男子坐在桌前，戴着耳机　哪一句描述正确？
o: He's putting on headphones.
He's taking off headphones.
He's wearing headphones.

drill.q: 【照片】一位女士正把外套套到身上　哪一句描述正确？
o: She's putting on a coat.
She's wearing a hat.
She's hanging up a coat.

steps.text: A man is leaning against a wall.
steps.focus: leaning against 连读，is 弱读成 /z/

steps.q: 【照片】一名技术员正在电脑后面调整线缆　哪一句描述正确？
o: A technician is buying some cables.
A technician is adjusting some cables.
A technician is talking on the phone.

steps.q: 【照片】清洁工正在擦窗户　哪一句描述正确？
o: A janitor is wiping a window.
A janitor is opening a window.
A janitor is looking out of a window.

steps.q: 【照片】几位乘客在排队上飞机　哪一句描述正确？
o: Passengers are leaving the airport.
Passengers are boarding a plane.
A plane is taking off.

steps.q: A man is ___ (examine) a document carefully.
a: examining

steps.q: A worker is ___ (kneel) down to repair a pipe.
a: kneeling

steps.a: A woman is pouring water into a glass.
steps.zh: 一位女士正往杯子里倒水。

steps.a: Some people are boarding a bus.

steps.zh: 她正伸手去拿架子上的书。
a: She is reaching for a book on the shelf.
She's reaching for a book on the shelf.

points: 动作动词：examine、pour、sweep、adjust、lift、board、lean against、reach for、wipe、kneel down。
重点：人物照 = 主语 + is / are doing；只说看得见的。
重点：wearing（戴着）≠ putting on（正在戴）。

steps.title: 没有人的照片
lines: Some books have been arranged on a shelf.
一些书被摆放在架子上。
A lamp is hanging from the ceiling.
一盏灯从天花板上垂下来。
Some chairs are stacked in the corner.
角落里摞着几把椅子。
Products are on display in a store window.
商品陈列在商店橱窗里。
steps.note: 没有人物的照片，描述的是物品的状态：被放在哪儿、摆成什么样。动词形式和人物照完全不同。

steps.title: 物品状态：has / have been done、is done、is doing（无动作的状态动词）
what: has / have been + 过去分词：已经被放好了 —— Some chairs have been stacked.
be + 过去分词：处于……状态 —— The door is closed. Products are displayed.
少数“状态动词”用进行时也表示静止：A lamp is hanging. A rug is lying on the floor.
why: 没有人的照片里，不会有人在“做”什么。所以出现 is being done（正在被做）的选项，多半是陷阱（见下一个重点）。
zh: 中文“椅子摞着”“灯挂着”是状态；英语用被动完成时或 be + 过去分词来表达，不用 someone is stacking。
ex: Some boxes have been loaded onto a truck.
一些箱子已被装上卡车。
The tables are arranged in a row.
桌子排成一排。
A rug is lying on the floor.
地上铺着一块地毯。
err: （照片里没人）Someone is arranging the books.
The books have been arranged on a shelf.
没人就不会有动作
steps.sum: 物品照：has been done / is done / is hanging, lying。

drill.q: 【照片】没有人；架子上整齐地放着几排瓶子　哪一句描述正确？
o: Some bottles are being washed.
A man is arranging some bottles.
Some bottles have been arranged on shelves.

drill.q: 【照片】没有人；墙上挂着一幅画　哪一句描述正确？
o: A woman is hanging a picture.
A picture is being painted.
A picture is hanging on the wall.

drill.zh: 一些椅子被摞在角落里。
a: Some chairs have been stacked in the corner.
Some chairs are stacked in the corner.

x: Some boxes have been stacked on the floor.
地上摞着几个箱子。

steps.title: is being done = 正在被……（照片里必须有人在做）
what: is / are being + 过去分词：正在被处理 —— A car is being repaired.（有人正在修车）
照片里没有人 → is being done 一般是错的
照片里有人正在做这件事 → 才可能是对的
why: 这是 Part 1 最经典的陷阱：The shelves are being stocked.（有人正在上货）vs The shelves have been stocked.（货已经上好了）。只差 being 一个词，要求照片里有没有人完全不同。
zh: 中文“车在修”可能是“正在修（有人在修）”，也可能是“修着呢（放在那儿）”。英语用 being 区分：有 being 必须看得见人在动手。
ex: （有人正在擦窗）The windows are being cleaned.
窗户正在被擦。
（窗户很干净，没人）The windows have been cleaned.
窗户已经擦干净了。
err: （没有人的仓库照片）Boxes are being loaded onto a truck.
Boxes have been loaded onto a truck.
没人 → 不能用 being
steps.sum: being = 照片里有人正在动手；没人就排除。

drill.q: 【照片】没有人；停车场里停着一排车　哪一句描述正确？
o: Cars are being parked.
A man is parking a car.
Cars are parked in a row.

drill.q: 【照片】一名工人正在给桌子刷漆　哪一句描述正确？
o: A table is being painted.
A table is lying on its side.
A table has been painted.

steps.text: Some chairs have been stacked in the corner.

steps.q: 【照片】没有人；商店橱窗里陈列着几件衣服　哪一句描述正确？
o: Some clothes are being folded.
Some clothes are on display in a window.
A woman is buying clothes.

steps.q: 【照片】没有人；厨房台面上放着几台小家电　哪一句描述正确？
o: A man is cooking dinner.
The counter is being cleaned.
Some appliances are on the counter.

steps.q: 【照片】没有人；天花板上吊着几盏灯　哪一句描述正确？
o: Some lamps are being installed.
Some lamps are hanging from the ceiling.
A worker is fixing a lamp.

steps.q: Some boxes have been ___ (stack) near the door.
a: stacked

steps.q: The chairs are arranged in a ___.
a: row

steps.a: Some books have been arranged on a shelf.
steps.zh: 一些书被摆放在架子上。

steps.a: A lamp is hanging from the ceiling.

a: Products are on display in the window.
Some products are on display in a store window.
Products are displayed in the window.

points: 物品：shelf、display、arrange、hang、row、lie、ceiling、lamp、counter、appliance、furnishings、stack。
重点：物品照用 has been done / is done / is hanging。
重点：is being done = 照片里有人正在做；没人就排除。

steps.title: 东西在哪儿
lines: Some plants have been placed along the corridor.
走廊边摆着一些盆栽。
Two people are sitting side by side in the lounge.
两个人并排坐在休息室里。
A sign is on top of the escalator.
扶梯顶上有一块指示牌。
Some vehicles are parked in the parking lot.
停车场里停着一些车。
steps.note: Part 1 的另一半分数在“位置”：东西在哪儿、人和东西是什么关系。介词听错，整句就错。

steps.title: Part 1 位置介词：along、on top of、between、in front of、behind、beside
what: along 沿着（一条线）：along the street / corridor
on top of 在顶上；under / beneath 在下面
between 两者之间；in front of 前面；behind 后面；beside / next to 旁边
across from 对面；in the middle of 中间
why: 干扰项常常动词、名词都对，只把介词换掉：The man is standing behind the counter. vs in front of。听的时候要特别注意介词。
zh: 中文“在……前面”位置词在名词后（桌子前面），英语介词在名词前（in front of the desk），听到介词时要立刻在脑子里定位。
ex: Trees are planted along the road.
路边种着树。
A woman is standing between two shelves.
一位女士站在两个货架之间。
A man is waiting in front of the elevator.
一名男子在电梯前等候。
err: Trees are planted on the road.
Trees are planted along the road.
沿着路两边用 along
A box is on the top the shelf.
A box is on top of the shelf.
固定说法 on top of
steps.sum: along / on top of / between / in front of / behind / across from。

drill.q: 【照片】一个男人站在柜台后面，给顾客找零　哪一句描述正确？
o: A man is standing in front of a counter.
A man is standing behind a counter.
A man is sitting on a counter.

drill.q: 【照片】道路两旁停满了车　哪一句描述正确？
o: Cars are parked along the street.
A car is being washed.
Cars are driving across a bridge.

drill.zh: 两个人并排坐在长椅上。
a: Two people are sitting side by side on a bench.
Two people are sitting next to each other on a bench.

x: The parking lot is almost full.
停车场快满了。
A box is on top of the cabinet.
柜子顶上有个箱子。
Two bicycles are parked side by side.
两辆自行车并排停着。
The chairs are lined up in a row.
椅子排成一排。
Two people are sitting facing each other.
两人面对面坐着。

steps.title: there be + 位置 + 状态：一句话描述场景
what: There is / are + 物 + 位置：There are some chairs in the lounge.
加状态：There are some cars parked along the street.（过去分词作后置定语）
人也可以：There are some people waiting at the gate.（-ing 作后置定语）
why: Part 1 很多正确答案就是 there be 句。注意后置的 parked / waiting 不是谓语，只是补充状态。
zh: 中文“街边停着一些车”主语是“车”，英语用 There are some cars parked along the street. 结构完整又地道。
ex: There are some people waiting in line.
有些人在排队等候。
There is a ladder leaning against the wall.
墙边靠着一架梯子。
err: There are some cars park along the street.
There are some cars parked along the street.
被停放 → parked
steps.sum: There are + 物 + parked / waiting + 位置。

drill.q: There are some passengers ___ on the platform.
o: waiting
waited
wait

drill.q: There are several bicycles ___ near the entrance.
o: park
parked
parking

steps.text: Two people are sitting side by side in the lounge.
steps.zh: 两个人并排坐在休息室里。
steps.focus: side by side 三个词连读

steps.q: 【照片】购物中心里，几个人正乘扶梯往上走　哪一句描述正确？
o: Some people are climbing a ladder.
An escalator is being repaired.
Some people are riding an escalator.

steps.q: 【照片】超市过道里空无一人，两边是货架　哪一句描述正确？
o: An aisle is lined with shelves.
A woman is pushing a cart down an aisle.
Shelves are being stocked.

steps.q: 【照片】两个人隔着桌子面对面坐着谈话　哪一句描述正确？
o: Two people are standing in a row.
Two people are sitting side by side.
Two people are sitting facing each other.

steps.q: Some plants have been placed ___ the corridor.
a: along
in

steps.q: A box is on ___ of the cabinet.
a: top

steps.a: There are some people waiting in the lounge.
steps.zh: 休息室里有些人在等候。

steps.a: Some vehicles are parked in the parking lot.

a: There are many empty seats in the cafeteria.
There are a lot of empty seats in the cafeteria.

points: 场所：aisle、corridor、escalator、stair、lounge、cafeteria、parking lot、fixture。
重点：along、on top of、between、in front of、behind、across from —— 干扰项常只换介词。
重点：There are + 物 + parked / waiting + 位置。
side by side、in a row、face each other。

steps.title: 听错一个词
lines: A worker is climbing a ladder.
一名工人正在爬梯子。
Some crates are being loaded onto a truck.
一些板条箱正被装上卡车。
A forklift is lifting some pallets.
叉车正在叉起几个托盘。
An architect is looking at a blueprint.
一位建筑师正在看图纸。
steps.note: Part 1 的干扰项会故意用发音相近的词（ladder / letter）或一个词的另一个意思（board 木板 / 上车）。

steps.title: 近音词陷阱
what: ladder（梯子）/ letter（信）· walk（走）/ work（工作）· copy（复印）/ coffee（咖啡）
lead（带领）/ read（读）· file（文件）/ pile（一堆）· sweep（扫）/ sleep（睡）
照片里有梯子，选项却说 writing a letter —— 典型近音陷阱。
why: 出题人知道考生会抓“听到的词”，所以会放一个和照片内容发音相似但意思不同的词。对策：听整句的意思，而不是捕捉单词。
zh: 中国学生 /l/ 和 /r/、/w/ 和 /v/ 不分，更容易被 lead / read、walk / work 骗。
ex: A man is climbing a ladder.
一名男子正在爬梯子。
A woman is writing a letter.
一位女士正在写信。
err: （照片：工人在梯子上）A worker is reading a letter.
A worker is climbing a ladder.
letter 是 ladder 的近音陷阱
steps.sum: 听意思，不抓单词：ladder / letter、copy / coffee、walk / work。

drill.q: 【照片】一位女士站在复印机前复印文件　哪一句描述正确？
o: A woman is making copies.
A woman is making coffee.
A woman is copying a recipe.

drill.q: 【照片】一名工人站在梯子上换灯泡　哪一句描述正确？
o: A worker is standing on a ladder.
A worker is reading a letter.
A worker is walking to work.

steps.title: 一词多义陷阱：board、row、lie、load
what: board：木板 / 公告板 / 董事会 / 登上（车、船、飞机）
row：一排 / 划船 · lie：躺 / 平放 · load：装货 / 负荷
check：检查 / 支票 · park：公园 / 停车
why: 照片里有人在上公交车，选项说 A woman is looking at a board（看公告板）—— 同一个 board，意思完全不同。
zh: 这些词的常见义大家都知道，Part 1 爱考的是第二个意思：board a bus、in a row、lie on the floor。
ex: Passengers are boarding a ferry.
乘客们正在登上渡轮。
Some boats are tied up in a row.
几条船排成一排拴着。
Some tools are lying on the ground.
地上放着一些工具。
err: A man is rowing the chairs.
The chairs are arranged in a row.
一排是 in a row
steps.sum: 注意第二个意思：board 上车、row 一排 / 划船、lie 平放。

drill.q: 【照片】码头边，几个人正在划船　哪一句描述正确？
o: People are boarding a plane.
Some people are rowing boats.
Some boats are in a row on the shore.

drill.q: Some tools are ___ on the workbench.
a: lying

steps.text: A forklift is lifting some pallets.
steps.zh: 叉车正在叉起几个托盘。

steps.q: 【照片】仓库里，一辆叉车正在搬运托盘　哪一句描述正确？
o: A truck is being washed.
Some pallets have been painted.
A forklift is moving some pallets.

steps.q: 【照片】工人们正在楼外搭脚手架　哪一句描述正确？
o: Some scaffolding is lying on the road.
Workers are putting up scaffolding.
Workers are taking a break.

steps.q: 【照片】一名工人在卸货，箱子从卡车上搬下来　哪一句描述正确？
o: A worker is loading a truck.
Some boxes are stacked in a warehouse.
A worker is unloading some boxes.

steps.q: A technician is ___ (install) a new air conditioner.
a: installing

steps.q: An ___ is looking at some blueprints.
a: architect

steps.a: A worker is climbing a ladder.
Some crates are being loaded onto a truck.

steps.zh: 一名男子正在修理一台机器。
a: A man is repairing a machine.
A man is fixing a machine.

points: 工地仓库：ladder、scaffolding、toolbox、forklift、pallet、crate、load、unload、install、repair、blueprint、architect。
重点：近音陷阱 ladder / letter、copy / coffee、walk / work —— 听意思。
重点：一词多义 board（上车）、row（一排 / 划船）、lie（平放）。

steps.title: 解题步骤
lines: Look at the photo before the audio starts.
录音开始前先看照片。
Ask yourself: who or what is in the photo, and what is happening?
问自己：照片里有谁 / 有什么，正在发生什么？
As you listen, cross out each wrong answer.
边听边排除错误选项。
Never choose a sentence about something you cannot see.
永远不要选描述照片里看不见的内容的句子。
steps.note: 这一课把前四课的方法串起来，做一套完整的 Part 1 模拟。

x: The speaker is standing at the podium.
演讲者站在讲台前。
A woman is leaning on the railing.
一位女士靠在栏杆上。
Some customers are browsing in a bookstore.
几位顾客在书店里随意翻看。
Coats are hanging on a rack.
外套挂在衣架上。
A boat is tied to the pier.
一艘船系在码头上。
A large vessel is sailing into the harbor.
一艘大船正驶入港口。

steps.title: Part 1 三步解题法
what: ① 预读：录音前用 5 秒看照片 —— 人还是物？几个人？主要动作？
② 排除：听一句排一句；动作错、主语错、介词错、照片里没有的东西 → 排除
③ 保留：剩下的最“保守”、最笼统的描述往往是答案
why: 正确答案很多时候“平平无奇”：A man is using a computer.；花哨的、带推测的（He is about to leave for a trip）几乎都是错的。
zh: 中国考生容易“想太多”，把照片读成故事。Part 1 只要“字面描述”。
ex: A man is speaking at a podium.
一名男子正在讲台上讲话。
Some people are browsing in a bookstore.
几个人在书店里随意翻看。
err: （照片：女士看菜单）She is going to order a steak.
She is looking at a menu.
推测的不选
steps.sum: 预读 → 排除 → 选最朴素的那句。

drill.q: 【照片】一个人在码头边扶着栏杆看海　哪一句描述正确？
o: A man is going to swim.
A man is buying a ticket for a boat.
A man is leaning on a railing.

drill.q: 【照片】服务员端着托盘走过餐厅　哪一句描述正确？
o: A customer is paying the bill.
A server is cooking in the kitchen.
A server is carrying a tray.

x: A waiter is carrying a tray of drinks.
服务员端着一托盘饮料。
She is speaking into a microphone.
她正对着麦克风讲话。
A man is mowing the lawn.
一名男子正在割草。
A gardener is trimming the bushes.
园丁正在修剪灌木。
He is polishing his shoes.
他正在擦皮鞋。

steps.title: 照片里“没有”的东西：全部排除
what: 选项里出现照片中看不到的名词（a car、a dog、customers）→ 直接排除
动词对、名词错也要排除：A woman is watering some flowers.（照片里她在浇树）
why: 这一条能排掉一半干扰项。听到第一个“照片里没有”的名词，就可以放弃这一句，把注意力留给下一句。
zh: 中文思维会“补全”画面（餐厅照片 → 应该有客人）；Part 1 不补全，只看实际出现的。
ex: A man is mowing the lawn.
一名男子正在修剪草坪。
Some clothes are hanging on a rack.
衣架上挂着一些衣服。
err: （照片只有衣架，没有人）A shopper is trying on a jacket.
Some clothes are hanging on a rack.
照片里没有购物者
steps.sum: 照片里看不到的名词一出现，整句排除。

drill.q: 【照片】没有人；一艘船停靠在码头边　哪一句描述正确？
o: A vessel is docked at a pier.
A captain is steering a boat.
Passengers are getting off a ship.

drill.q: 【照片】一名男子在擦皮鞋　哪一句描述正确？
o: A man is buying new shoes.
A man is putting on his socks.
A man is polishing his shoes.

steps.text: Look at the photo before the audio starts.

steps.q: 【照片】商店里，几个人在挂满衣服的衣架前挑选　哪一句描述正确？
o: Some people are browsing through a clothing rack.
Some people are paying at the counter.
The clothes are being sewn.

steps.q: 【照片】一名园丁正在修剪树篱　哪一句描述正确？
o: A gardener is trimming some bushes.
Some bushes are being moved.
A gardener is planting trees.

steps.q: 【照片】讲台上放着一支麦克风，没有人　哪一句描述正确？
o: A microphone has been placed on a podium.
A microphone is being adjusted.
A speaker is giving a talk.

steps.q: A man is ___ (mow) the lawn.
a: mowing

steps.q: Some clothes are hanging on a ___.
a: rack

steps.a: A server is carrying a tray of drinks.
steps.zh: 服务员端着一托盘饮料。

steps.a: A vessel is docked at a pier.

steps.zh: 一名男子正在讲台上讲话。
a: A man is speaking at a podium.
A man is giving a speech at a podium.
A man is talking at a podium.

points: 新词：podium、railing、browse、rack、pier、vessel、tray、microphone、mow、trim、polish、plant。
重点：预读 → 排除 → 选最朴素的描述。
重点：照片里看不到的名词一出现就排除。
Part 1 四大陷阱：推测、wearing / putting on、is being done、近音和多义词。

lessons.title: 单元阅读：Morning at the Harbor

steps.title: Morning at the Harbor
steps.note: 一段“文字照片”：读的时候在脑子里画出画面，再判断哪些描述能从“照片”里看出来。
lines: It is early morning at a small harbor.
清晨，一个小港口。
Several fishing boats are tied up in a row along the pier.
几艘渔船沿着码头排成一排系着。
On the closest boat, a man is unloading crates of fish.
最近的那艘船上，一名男子正在卸一箱箱的鱼。
Another man is standing on the pier and lifting the crates onto a cart.
另一名男子站在码头上，把箱子搬到推车上。
A woman in a yellow jacket is leaning on the railing.
一位穿黄色外套的女士靠在栏杆上。
She is looking at the boats and holding a cup of coffee.
她一边看着船，一边端着一杯咖啡。
Behind her, some tables and chairs have been set up in front of a small café.
她身后，一家小咖啡馆门前摆好了一些桌椅。
The café is not open yet, and no one is sitting outside.
咖啡馆还没开门，外面没有人坐着。
Far away, a large vessel is sailing out of the harbor.
远处，一艘大船正驶出港口。
A few seagulls are flying above the water.
几只海鸥在水面上飞。

steps.q: Which sentence matches the scene?
o: Some boats are being painted.
The pier is crowded with tourists.
Some boats are tied up in a row.

steps.q: What is the woman doing?
o: Serving coffee in a café
Leaning on a railing
Unloading crates

steps.q: Which sentence is NOT true?
o: Some customers are sitting outside the café.
Tables and chairs have been set up.
A vessel is sailing out of the harbor.
steps.e: The café is not open yet, and no one is sitting outside. —— 没有人坐着。

steps.q: "Some tables and chairs have been set up" describes
o: 物品已经摆好的状态
桌椅将要被摆放
有人正在摆桌椅
steps.e: has / have been done = 已被……（状态）。

steps.zh: 一名男子正在卸一箱箱的鱼。
a: A man is unloading crates of fish.
A man is unloading some crates of fish.

points: Part 1 语言：is unloading / is leaning on / have been set up / are tied up in a row。
人物照用 is doing；物品状态用 has been done。
词：pier、crate、railing、vessel、in a row。

extra.q: 【照片】一名男子戴着安全帽在工地　哪一句描述正确？
o: He's wearing a helmet.
He's buying a helmet.
He's putting on a helmet.

extra.q: 【照片】没有人；桌上的文件摞成一堆　哪一句描述正确？
o: Papers are being printed.
Someone is stacking papers.
Some papers have been stacked on a desk.

extra.q: 【照片】几位乘客正在上火车　哪一句描述正确？
o: A train is being cleaned.
Passengers are boarding a train.
Passengers are leaving a station.

extra.q: 【照片】一个女人站在两个书架之间　哪一句描述正确？
o: A woman is standing between two bookshelves.
A woman is standing in front of a store.
A woman is sitting on a shelf.

extra.q: 【照片】工人在梯子上粉刷墙壁　哪一句描述正确？
o: A worker is writing a letter.
A worker is painting a wall.
A wall is lying on the floor.

extra.q: 【照片】没有人；停车场里车排成一排　哪一句描述正确？
o: Cars are being parked.
A driver is parking a car.
Cars are parked in a row.

extra.zh: 一位女士正往杯子里倒咖啡。
a: A woman is pouring coffee into a cup.
A woman is pouring some coffee into a cup.
A ladder is leaning against the wall.
There is a ladder leaning against the wall.
